verdict.rationale: Navan's API/MCP covers expense retrieval/update, transactions, custom fields, receipts, webhooks, and read-style spend/policy queries, but there is no evidence of API parity for travel booking, rewards, or other core UI workflows (e.g., booking trips, managing 'price to beat', Navan Edge concierge features) — those remain UI/chat-only per docs. missing for 10: API endpoints for travel booking/itinerary management, evidence of full UI-to-API parity beyond expense/finance domain, independent confirmation of completeness.
